Track 2 follow-up to `ambient-misread`: estimate the urgency label's prior and confusion matrix from an audit set of n messages, then act by Bayes' rule. Stylised, simulated only. About 50 audited messages recover 76% of the true-parameter gain at 70% label accuracy; n=10 is worse than ignoring the label unless smoothed. 6 tests, `python site/build.py` ok.
